title: For each academic year and school, provide the academic year, academic year
question: For each academic year and school, provide the academic year, academic year description, school name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered in that year and school (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units, terms that are not the current term, and only subjects offered by the Mathematics department), as well as the average, maximum range, and average variance of the department budget codes for degree-granting departments in that school (excluding the 'Political Science' department), and the number of unique subject codes associated with those degree-granting departments (excluding 'Political Science'). The columns should be: academic year, academic year description, school name, total units range, total units variance, average department budget code, maximum range of department budget code, average variance of department budget code, and number of unique subject codes. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH units_stats AS (
  SELECT
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range,
    VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
  JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso
    ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
    ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0
    AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N'
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
  GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, sd.SCHOOL_NAME
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    AVG(CAST(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS DECIMAL(20,0))) AS avg_dept_budget,
    MAX(CAST(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS DECIMAL(20,0))) - MIN(CAST(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS DECIMAL(20,0))) AS max_range_dept_budget,
    VARIANCE(CAST(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS DECIMAL(20,0))) AS avg_var_dept_budget,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_codes
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd
  JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
    ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
  GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME
)
SELECT
  u.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  u.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  u.SCHOOL_NAME,
  u.total_units_range,
  u.total_units_variance,
  d.avg_dept_budget,
  d.max_range_dept_budget,
  d.avg_var_dept_budget,
  d.unique_subject_codes
FROM units_stats u
JOIN dept_stats d
  ON u.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY u.ACADEMIC_YEAR, u.SCHOOL_NAME
